title: Operational Collapse Region in Repeaterless Loss-Dephasing Quantum Channels
summary: The distribution of entangled photon pairs over standard optical fiber is a fundamental requirement for the realization of the quantum internet. However, real-world deployment is severely bottlenecked by the interplay of amplitude damping (photon loss) and phase noise (birefringence). In this paper, we numerically investigate the degradation of dual-rail polarization entanglement in telecom C-band fiber links.
